name: MiniMax H3 — image to video + audio (4-step turbo)
description:
Upload a picture and describe what should happen: your image becomes the first frame and MiniMax H3 animates it into a short video **with a matching audio track**. Describe the motion, the camera move and the sounds you want to hear; you can refer to your image as <Picture 1>.

The video keeps the shape (aspect ratio) of your picture. "Size" sets the resolution: 0.4 megapixels (about 864x480 for a landscape photo) is a good classroom default, 1.0 is close to the 768p the turbo LoRA was trained at and looks better but takes noticeably longer.

"Fast mode" (on by default) uses the 4-step turbo LoRA and is roughly 4x faster than the plain 20-step render. Size and duration drive the cost far more than anything else — time grows roughly with width x height x seconds.
author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.label: Prompt (action / camera / sound - refer to the image as <Picture 1>)
exposedParameters.default:
The scene from <Picture 1> comes to life. The camera slowly pushes in while the main subject begins to move naturally; light shifts gently and small details in the background drift and sway.
Audio: soft ambient sound that matches the scene, subtle movement sounds, no music.

exposedParameters.label: Size in megapixels (0.4 = 864x480 for a 16:9 picture, 1.0 = 1376x768)
